@@U03646@@
I'll come, too.

@@U03648@@
What a remarkable trinity! God and man and spirit all in step! (忒尔喀涅斯众神 OF 罗得岛 appear on hippocamps and sea dragons, brandishing 涅普顿: trident.)

@@U03650@@
We forged this trident for 涅普顿, and with it he rules the wildest of waves. When the Thunderer unleashes his pregnant clouds, 涅普顿 answers the horrible rumble by rousing the sea to a violent response. As bolts of lightning plunge jaggedly downward, 涅普顿’s waves dash upward to meet them, wave upon waye, mountain high. And whoever in ships is caught in between is tossed and blown till the sea overwhelms them, dragging them down to the sea’s watery deeps. And so, he’s lent us his scepter for the day, allowing us peace and joy in our play.

@@U03652@@
Welcome, devotees of 赫利俄斯, Bless¢d ones who honor light, Join us as we honor Luna, Glorious goddess of the night!

@@U03654@@
Dearest of goddesses aloft in your orbit, with what delight you hear your brother praised, lending an ear to bless¢d 罗得岛, where a neverending hymn to him is raised. At the start and at the close of his daily round, he looks down upon us with his fiery gaze.
translation:
@@U03646@@
我也来吧

@@U03648@@
这是多么了不起的三位一体啊！神、人、灵都步调一致！ （罗得岛的忒尔喀涅斯众神出现在海马和海龙上，挥舞着涅普顿：三叉戟。）

@@U03650@@
我们为涅普顿铸造了这把三叉戟，他用它统治着最狂野的海浪。当雷霆释放出孕育的云彩时，涅普顿以激起大海的剧烈反应来回应可怕的隆隆声。当一道道闪电锯齿般地向下坠落时，涅普顿的波浪向上冲去，一浪接一浪，山高。船上的任何人被夹在中间都会被抛来抛去，直到海水淹没他们，将他们拖入大海的深处。因此，他今天借给了我们他的权杖，让我们在游戏中享受平静和欢乐。

@@U03652@@
欢迎，赫利俄斯的信徒们，尊敬光明的有福之人，加入我们，一起纪念光荣的夜女神露娜！

@@U03654@@
在你的轨道上最亲爱的女神，你多么高兴地听到你的兄弟受到赞扬，侧耳倾听祝福罗得岛，在那里为他唱响永不停歇的赞美诗。在每天的巡视开始和结束时，他都会用火热的目光俯视着我们。
